description:
Professional, real-time animation software.

Cavalry is a powerful 2D Animation software for macOS and Windows making waves in the worlds of animation, motion design, creative coding, film, generative art, data visualisation, experiential and advertising.
Enhancements
- Hotkeys are now included for rows in the Command Search.
- Performance improvements to the Glow Filter.
- Cmd/Ctrl + A is now supported in the Graph Editor to select all keyframes.
- Alpha is now supported for imported WebM assets.
- New Clear Guides command added to the Composition menu.
Notable Bug Fixes
- The Fill Color Filter now supports Mattes.
- .csv assets (including Canva and Google Sheets) now correctly return characters with certain accents (e.g. à) which are the last character in a cell.
- A Render Token used in a Path is now read correctly meaning incorrect warnings about non-existent paths are no longer thrown.
- An issue meaning connection anchors were incorrectly appearing in a Project Palette has been resolved.
- Type to search in the Deformers/Filters lists has been restored.
- Children of a 2.5d Layer within a Pre-Comp without a Camera now render as expected in a parent Composition.
- Opacity settings for Groups are now respected when adding .af files to Compositions as 'Individual Layers'.
- Transform Only motion blur with High Quality Samples checked no longer fails.
- Feathering for Clipping Masks no longer fails at 90/270º Shape rotations.
- An incorrect expression error thrown when leaving numeric fields blank has been resolved.
- Boolean operations mode buttons no longer incorrectly affect other rows.
- Boolean settings for individual input Layers are now preserved when closing and reopening the Attribute Editor UI.
- The Dependency Graph is now correctly updated when reordering Array indices.
- The half of a port that sits outside a Layer's panel in the Dependency Graph is now clickable.
- SVGs containing gradients pasted to Cavalry as an 'Asset Layer' now save to file correctly.
- An issue meaning the Formatted String String Generator would fail when a $ symbol was referenced from an index.
- Holding Cmd/Ctrl when removing connections in the popover window now keeps the popover window open as expected.
- Another attempt at fixing the 'stuck hand cursor' issue has been made (no fully reproducible steps known).
- Audio playback now respects a Pre-Comp's settings and/or its clip.
- api.importPalette() now converts .ase and .theme files to .pal (as per the UI).
- 'Full' Motion Blur support for Auto-Animate.
- An issue meaning the MCP Server could cause Cavalry to crash on quit on Windows has been resolved.
- Hotkeys for other tools now work when the Text tool is active.
- A regression meaning a Reference located outside a Project would not load correctly when opening a Scene has been resolved.
- An issue meaning a subset of Windows users were being presented with a 'Bad Image' OS dialogue has been resolved.
- Several Lottie fixes:
  - Easing curves that overshoot are now preserved.
  - Editable Shapes are no longer painted twice.
  - Step keys now correctly export as holds.
  - Out points are no longer one frame short.
  - Children of 'guide' Layers are now exported.
  - Attributes with a single keyframe are no longer marked as animated.
  - Holds are now used when baking animations (when needed).
  - Mask modes now follow Cavalry's mask stack.
  - Skew is now supported.
  - Groups are now converted to Null Layers rather than empty Shape Layers.
  - Lottie version fixed.
  - In and Out points for Groups are no longer set to 0 (Shapes were being hidden).
  - The full-bake mode is no longer off by one frame.
  - Gradient fill with a trimmed stroke no longer crashes on export.
  - Pivot values no longer create a double transform.
  - Fill Rule is now exported.
  - Layers that share image assets are retained.
Notes
- Given the rise of AI reverse engineering, the word 'encrypt' has been replaced with 'encode' for third-party scripts. The change is backwards compatible so legacy scripts are still supported.
- THe Background Rendering feature has been temporarily removed from the Render Manager as it relies on the CLI.
- The CLI is not available in Cavalry 2.8.1 so if you are using this feature, please remain on your current version. We are working towards reinstating this for future versions.
